_about: Variant 1: three worked camp nights of the vertical slice. Player = Brennic (Fire). The slice is the last three days of a camp week: day 1 = weekday 5, day 2 = weekday 6 (Tent Trial), day 3 = weekday 7 (Tiro Games). Every number below follows design/data/*.csv|json; dice are seeded d20 draws shown as their result. Code decides every outcome; the Crier only writes the board text. Night 3 shows a rejected live board falling back to the bank.
rulesUsedHere: socialize: +6 both ways; +9 when cross-tent and equal rank (activities.csv)
help: target trust toward helper +10; debt(target, helper) +1; target hunger -30 (one ration)
walking past a begging Stray: trust(stray, walker) -5 (situations.json strays.rules)
same tent, same rank pairs: -1 trust each way per night (duality)
hunger +15 per night for the unfed (Strays always; tent members when tent stores < members); hunger >= 50 at night: tent loyalty -5
defection: loyalty < 20 AND trust(x, m) >= 20 for m in another tent whose elder accepts (warmth >= 6 or stores >= 6); at most 1 defection per night

rumour: heard by the starter's tent, the target's tent, and (when the target is one of the four mains) the other three mains; reactions by rumourReactionTable; a listener whose trust toward the target is >= 20 disbelieves it (no reaction)
Tent Trial score = bout 0.5 + elder trust/100 * 0.3 + renown/100 * 0.2
Games payout = the stage reached: [20, 40, 60, 100] gold; renown [5, 10, 15, 25] (arena-tiers.json); nobody dies below the Summa (missio at 0 HP)
after a Games bout, a winner with honour in values offers a hand: pairTrust +6

items.line: They say Iskar and Dace drew a fifth circle by the Ditch last night. The elders call it a children's game.

privateJournal.line: The four of you at the Well. Cassia wants to know what the Wardstones drink. So do you, now.
A sealed tablet at the grille: thirty gold if you fall in the next semifinal. The Lanista's seal.

nights.counterfactual: Had Brennic won the final: payout 100 and renown +25 (rank-up progress toward Veteranus), Senna's honour hand-shake still fires (the rule is the winner's honour, so it would be Brennic offering it only if the player chooses the 'offer your hand' prompt). Doros's defection and Dace's pledge do not depend on the player at all: the world moves without you.
